method: Actual encoded full-map crops, same projection and outputpixel scale; enlarged with nearest pixels for inspection. This is not the separate controlled ROI simulation.

independent_visual_assessment.verdict: PASS: repeated sharp mesh teeth are absent in reviewed actual whole-map encoded samples.
observations: Matched actual whole-map frames0,150,300,450 show the old vertical/angular sawtooth row replaced by continuous curving trails.
The broad weak and reversing shear lane remains visible; it has not been filled with uniform flow or painted over.
The actual full encoded movie agrees with the controlled same-scale preview and numerical continuity/trajectory checks.
limitations: Display interpolation preserves original source centres and masks, not native element means or transport.
The broad feature is from a sampled model vector mean, not directly observed local current measurements.
Trail motion is enhanced and has no single physical time scale.
